data.body: **[P2] Include earlier updates from the same request in consistency checks.** This lookup only sees persisted operations. A checkpoint may contain `START` followed by a terminal update for the same STEP or CONTEXT ID, so that second update can change its type, subtype, name, or parent without detection, producing history the service rejects as non-deterministic. Track effective metadata while iterating the request, seeded from `checkpointOperations`, and add a same-request START/terminal regression test.
